headline: XP Sees Interest Rate Cuts Paused Until End of 2027 Amid Inflation Pressures
summary: XP projects a pause in Brazil's interest rate cuts until the end of 2027 amid a negative inflation scenario, real depreciation, higher oil prices, and rising medium-term inflation expectations.
why: Monetary policy projections from major financial institutions guide fixed-income pricing, yield curve positioning, and corporate borrowing strategies in Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Prolonged high interest rate expectations impact debt servicing and borrowing costs.
